warp.bot: Use this to draft or schedule an Instagram, X, Facebook, or LinkedIn post. Prefer exportId (Studio export UUID) or elementVariationId when posting Studio/element stills — JoAi copies those images onto the post and leaves the originals alone. Otherwise upload with media_upload and pass IDs in media. Do not combine media with exportId or elementVariationId. Set scheduledAt in the team timezone when the user names a time - that only queues the post; JoAi's publish job posts to the network later. Omit scheduledAt to keep a draft. Platforms: instagram, x, facebook, linkedin.

description.en: Network to post on
description.de: Netzwerk für den Post

description.en: Post caption or tweet text
description.de: Bildunterschrift oder Tweet-Text

inputs.name: Images

description.en: Ordered team media IDs, e.g. ["abc","def"]. Instagram: JPEG 1–10. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Upload with media_upload first. Do not combine with exportId or elementVariationId.
description.de: Team-Medien-IDs in Reihenfolge, z.B. ["abc","def"]. Instagram: JPEG 1–10. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Zuerst mit media_upload hochladen. Nicht zusammen mit exportId oder elementVariationId.

inputs.bot: JSON array of media IDs from media_upload, in order. Optional for X, Facebook, and LinkedIn text-only posts. Mutually exclusive with exportId and elementVariationId. JoAi copies media onto the post.

inputs.name: Studio export

description.en: Studio export UUID. Copies still images from that export onto the post. Mutually exclusive with media and elementVariationId.
description.de: Studio-Export-UUID. Kopiert Standbilder aus dem Export auf den Post. Nicht zusammen mit media oder elementVariationId.

inputs.bot: UUID from studio_export / project export. Use instead of media when posting Studio stills.

inputs.name: Element variation

description.en: Element variation ID. Copies the variation images (primary first) onto the post. Mutually exclusive with media and exportId.
description.de: Element-Variation-ID. Kopiert die Variationsbilder (Primär zuerst) auf den Post. Nicht zusammen mit media oder exportId.

inputs.bot: Hashid from list_element_variations / generate_element_variation. Use instead of media when posting element stills.

description.en: When JoAi should publish. ISO time. Without a timezone, the team timezone is used. Omit to save a draft. Scheduling queues the post; the publish job posts later.
description.de: Wann JoAi veröffentlichen soll. ISO-Zeit. Ohne Zeitzone gilt die Team-Zeitzone. Weglassen speichert einen Entwurf. Planen reiht ein; der Publish-Job postet später.
